title: CODATA 2022: the electron g factor is −2.002 319 304 360 92
summary: The standard uncertainty is 0.000 000 000 000 36. The departure from −2 is the magnetic-moment anomaly.
body: The NIST 2022 listing prints 'electron g factor −2.002 319 304 360 92' with standard uncertainty '0.000 000 000 000 36'. The same listing prints 'electron mag. mom. anomaly 1.159 652 180 46 e-3' with standard uncertainty '0.000 000 000 18 e-3'. The g factor is not −2 exactly in this adjustment. The anomaly is the measured difference that the listing prints beside it.
